summary: Verdict-ref deadlock: #2427 (AISDLC-1196 fix for the ship lease-fallback and skip-plan defects) and #2429 (AISDLC-1198) have no refs/ai-sdlc/verdicts/<head> because the ship step on main's pipeline build dropped the ref, so the merge gate refuses the very fix. A plain re-entry on main's build hits the unchanged-content skip and writes no record. Choose the one-off path that lands #2427.

options.description: Dispatch re-enters AISDLC-1196 once with AI_SDLC_PIPELINE_REF=d63ca322 (the reviewed fix at the PR head) so the review round runs on the fixed pipeline build and pushes the verdict ref atomically; same lane as the AISDLC-1024 hotfix pin, pointed at the fix instead of known-good. Then #2429 and #2413 re-enter on main after 1196 lands.

Planner builds a verdict record from the round-1 review-state (3 approvals, head 6c1d630f) and pushes refs/ai-sdlc/verdicts/d63ca322 by hand. Fast but a hand-authored trust record; weakens the machine-only verdict control.
Operator merges #2427 with the verdict check bypassed (branch-protection admin). Class (c), weakens the gate once.
